Title: Senior Customer Data Scientist
Description: H2O.ai is on a mission to democratize AI for Good. As the world’s leading agentic AI company, H2O.ai converges Generative and Predictive AI to help enterprises and public sector agencies develop purpose-built Agents, SLMs, and solutions on their private data. With a focus on secure, compliant, and infrastructure-flexible Sovereign AI deployments, H2O.ai delivers solutions that align with the highest standards of data privacy and control. Its open-source technology is trusted by over 20,000 organizations worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 500. H2O.ai powers AI transformation for companies like AT&T, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Wells Fargo, Bank of America, Workday, Progressive Insurance, and NIH. For more information, visit www.h2o.ai. About This Opportunity Are you a data scientist or machine learning engineer who enjoys solving real-world problems by applying cutting edge Gen AI/ML algorithms? Are you passionate about working with customers to solve their business challenges? Can you explain complex machine learning concepts in simple business terms? If the answer is “yes”, then we have a position for you! What You Will Do Deliver data science and/or machine learning professional services to the customers. This will entail working closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, preprocess, and analyze data to develop data-driven solutions. Support customers by helping to build custom data models, transformation, scorers/optimization loss functions/metrics that can be leveraged with H2O Driverless AI and help improve training performance for the customer use cases/domains. Ability to design and run training sessions for our customers in data science concepts as well as using H2O products. Training will need to be able to be delivered to audiences with varying data science skills and abilities. Help customers understand the nuances of data science, expert settings of H2O Driverless AI and H2O open source, and the strategies of experiment tuning that you would use to incrementally improve model performance. This also includes explaining model performance, model interpretability, and post deployment model monitoring concepts so as to ensure the business is making the right decisions on the model predictions. Participate in the development of ML solutions and AI applications for internal use, contributing to the advancement of our technology stack. What We Are Looking For Proven experience in data science, machine learning, and AI with a minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience. Experience with solving machine learning problems using H2O products (plus), Python, R. Knowledge and experience of using a variety of machine learning techniques (supervised/unsupervised, clustering, decision tree learning, neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks/tuning techniques. Knowledge and experience of using advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests and proper usage, etc.) for practical applications. Knowledge and experience in statistical and data mining techniques: GLM/Regression, Random Forest, Boosting, Trees, text mining, social network analysis, etc. Experience of visualizing and presenting (EDA) to stakeholders using H2O Wave (plus), or other standard data visualization libraries in the Python and R stacks or using Tableau/PowerBi. Understanding and experience with post production model monitoring concepts and tools like H2O ML Ops (plus) MLFlow etc. In depth understanding of machine learning algorithms and experience applying Gen AI/ML to solve real work problems, including deployment of end to end ML pipelines. Interest in Generative AI and Large Language Models (Prompt Engineering, Retrieval Augmented Generation, LLMOps, Making custom LLM models, fine tuning etc, Guardrails). Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Why H2O.ai? Market leader in total rewards Remote-friendly culture Flexible working environment Be part of a world-class team Career growth H2O.ai is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status or any other legally protected basis. H2O.ai is an innovative AI cloud platform company, leading the mission to democratize AI for everyone. Thousands of organizations from all over the world have used our cutting-edge technology across a variety of industries. We’ve made it easy for people at all levels to generate breakthrough solutions to complex business problems and advance the discovery of new ideas and revenue streams. We push the boundaries of what is possible with artificial intelligence. H2O.ai employs the world’s top Kaggle Grandmasters, the community of best-in-the-world machine learning practitioners and data scientists. A strong AI for Good ethos and responsible AI drive the company’s purpose. Please visit www.H2O.ai to learn more.

Title: Commercial Data Jr Analyst
Description: Título del Puesto: Analista de Data Science Duccio para Consultoría Comercial para Empresas de Gran Consumo Descripción del Puesto: Como Analista de Data Science en Duccio serás responsable de analizar y extraer información clave a partir de conjuntos de datos complejos para en el sector comercial de empresas de gran consumo. Tu trabajo será fundamental para ayudar a nuestros clientes a tomar decisiones estratégicas basadas en datos sólidos y análisis predictivos. Buscamos a un profesional con experiencia en el sector de Retail o Consumo Masivo, que posea habilidades analíticas avanzadas y capacidad para comunicar eficazmente los hallazgos a los equipos internos y clientes. Responsabilidades: Recopilar, limpiar y analizar grandes conjuntos de datos relacionados con el comportamiento del consumidor, ventas, inventario y otros aspectos relevantes para el sector de gran consumo. Desarrollar modelos predictivos y algoritmos para identificar tendencias, patrones de compra y oportunidades de optimización. Realizar análisis exploratorios de datos para descubrir insights y recomendaciones que impulsen la toma de decisiones estratégicas. Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos internos y clientes para comprender sus necesidades y diseñar soluciones analíticas a medida. Título universitario en Estadística, Economía, Matemáticas, Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería u otro campo relacionado. Orientación hacia el trabajo en equipo y capacidad para colaborar efectivamente con personas de diversos perfiles y niveles jerárquicos. Aptitud para trabajar en un entorno dinámico y gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente, manteniendo altos estándares de calidad y precisión. Ofrecemos: Oportunidad de formar parte de un equipo altamente especializado en consultoría comercial para el sector de gran consumo. Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y dinámico, con oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo profesional continuo. Participación en proyectos desafiantes y variados, con la posibilidad de impactar en la toma de decisiones de empresas líderes en el mercado. Esta descripción del puesto está diseñada para atraer a candidatos con la combinación adecuada de habilidades técnicas, experiencia en el sector y cualidades interpersonales necesarias para tener éxito como Analista de Data Science en Duccio

Title: Analyst, Financial Fraud Risk
Description: Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! ㅤ Your new role Skydance is looking for a Fraud Risk Analyst to join the Global Fraud & Abuse Operations Team to support in detecting and preventing risks across all WBD properties. This team is at the forefront of ensuring a seamless and frictionless experience for consumers while protecting the revenue of the business. As a global unit, we are looking for candidates across our many offices around the world to support in our fight against fraud and abuse 24x7. A successful candidate will have a curious mind, who thinks outside the box, and who enjoys solving complex problems with data. If you have an interest in data analysis, investigations, stopping fraud, and, most importantly, advocating for the consumer, then this role is “The One to Apply”. Your role accountabilities You will assist in optimizing risk decisions in the fraud platform by: Reviewing and validating the performance of machine learning models. Creating and reviewing fraud rules to complement the models or to support business policy rules.​ Providing feedback to the models to continually improve their efficacy. You will drive opportunities through data by implementing: Anomaly detection alerts to capture potential fraud and abuse faster. Pro-active Investigative processes to find fraud and abuse trends that were incorrectly tagged by the model and update the tagging (i.e., false positives and false negatives). You will collaborate with teams to drive a one culture mindset, such as: Payment Operations on chargeback monitoring and new and existing payment method risks. Customer service and ways to improve communications around payment fraud and abuse issues. Payment Product and Engineering teams on new feature requests and enhancements. Qualifications & Experience At least 1+ years of experience in fraud analytics. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Analytics, Statistics or other similar discipline or comparable business experience Availability to work a designated shift from Tuesday through Thursday as part of a 24x7 global fraud operations environment. Strong project management skills , with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, track deliverables, and drive projects through completion. Knowledge/Skills Proficient in SQL. Have directly worked with fraud vendors that use machine learning and rules systems. Experience in ETL processing and/or Data Visualization tools (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) is a plus. Familiarity with payment industry regulations is a plus. Management has the right to add or change duties and job requirements at any time. About Skydance Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central. Title: Data Associate - Sensors & Data
Description: Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape. For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments. Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected. By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe. This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead. Wood Mackenzie Intelligence Connected WoodMac.com Wood Mackenzie Brand Video Wood Mackenzie Values Inclusive – we succeed together Trusting – we choose to trust each other Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions Future Focused – we accelerate change Curious – we turn knowledge into action We are looking for an Associate to work as part of our Commodities Sensors & Data team covering the Short-Term Power Data segment. Main Responsibilities Assist a global team in supporting a network of proprietary measurement devices across three continents Execute calibration models that establish data quality and accuracy for our customers across multiple proprietary technologies to support multiple product lines Run support applications to ensure high data quality and accuracy Perform benchmark tests on data sets to validate accuracy Analyze data to identify broken or malfunctioning equipment, and work with a field repair team to address issues Assist senior analysts with the process of bringing new monitored facilities online Manipulate large datasets to identify areas of improvement in data accuracy Collaborate with Wood Mackenzie’s team of data scientists and developers to continuously improve current techniques and processes Perform data quality checks and share findings with wider Power team. Research information relating to the power industry and maintain a fundamental understanding of the power markets and available datasets. Conduct ad-hoc analysis and verification as needed by internal and external customers Provide general support for customers in their daily process via multiple communication channels Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the sectors we cover and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie. Research and data gathering – we identify and gather intelligence that feeds our industry expertise. We need inquisitive and passionate people with a keen eye for detail. Analysis - we provide market-leading research using this data/intelligence and form opinions for, and tell stories to, our customers. We need people with natural curiosity with potential to become experts in their field, and with the ability to articulate – both verbally and in writing – clear, insightful analysis. Internal engagement – we work with colleagues across the Wood Mackenzie business to deliver a compelling, integrated view of the natural resources sector to customers through our cutting-edge products. For this, we need people who are as comfortable working collaboratively as they are independently and who have excellent interpersonal skills. External engagement – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand. This requires people with the potential to become industry experts who have intellectual curiosity, passion, and excellent presentation skills. Continuous improvement – at Wood Mackenzie, we are committed to transform the way we power our planet. The energy transition is here, and this impacts our customer base and how we serve them. We need colleagues with a change mindset, who are flexible, growth-orientated, and proactive. About You You have a keen interest in commodity market dynamics, and you want to develop an in-depth understanding of how these markets underpin the natural resources industry and impact our everyday lives. You have an analytical mindset and an eye for detail, which have been proven in your academic and/or work experience to date with a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a STEM field. Your attention to detail includes identifying patterns, anomalies, and normalization within datasets and publications; and your analytical mindset enables you to focus on unique problem solving. You are curious and seek to clarify and enhance your knowledge by asking thoughtful questions. You are a highly adaptive team player and embrace fast-paced environments with frequent change. You are excited to be part of a team that give you opportunities to work cross-functionally on a variety of tasks. You can work independently and as part of a global and regional team, generating ideas you want to share. The way in which you work is productive and driven, striving to be best in class. You have an excellent command of English, both written and spoken. You are comfortable collecting and interpreting data, articulating your findings in a clear and insightful manner. You also have a good working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite, with strong Excel skills including v/h lookups, formula relationships, pivot tables, macros/VBA. You have basic experience with SQL, including joins, inline select statements, date & time manipulation. Where you have been is important, but we are more interested in where you can go. We’re looking for Associates with a genuine passion for energy and natural resources who have the potential to grow at Wood Mackenzie. You may be a recent graduate, looking for a career change, or returning to work after a break. Wood Mackenzie has adopted a hybrid approach, and we expect people to be present in our offices on average 2 days per week. Equal Opportunities We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Title: Solution Analyst Intern
Industries: Software Development and IT Services and IT Consulting
Description: Our Company At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information.  Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes.  With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters.  Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach.  Teradata delivers real business value with AI. Our Internship Program Our Mexico Intern program starts in September ending in March.  We offer a fast-paced, flexible, fun environment where you will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects and face new challenges.  Our culture isn’t just about one kind of person.  So many individuals make up who we are, making us that much more unique.  This is what sets apart the dynamic, diverse, and collaborative environment that is Teradata. What You’ll Do You will contribute across the analytics delivery lifecycle—from understanding data and building solutions, to exploring AI capabilities that help our team work smarter. Explore and analyze data using SQL and Python, asking business questions, spotting patterns, and turning raw datasets into clear, actionable insights for internal stakeholders. Build and test analytics prototypes—dashboards, reports, or data models—that give teams faster access to the information they need to make decisions. Experiment with AI and agentic tools on top of Teradata’s platform, helping automate repetitive analyst tasks and surface insights that would otherwise take days to find manually. Validate data quality across pipelines—checking for completeness, accuracy, and consistency—and flag issues with clear documentation so engineers can act quickly. Act as a Customer Zero advocate: use Teradata’s own autonomous knowledge platform capabilities day-to-day, compare them honestly against best-in-class tools in the market, and share structured feedback that helps shape what we build next. What You'll Gain Real project experience on a live analytics platform used by a global enterprise—not a training sandbox—so you graduate with work you can talk about in any interview. A practical understanding of how AI is being applied inside a data company right now: what works, what doesn’t, and how teams make decisions about which tools to adopt. Mentorship from senior engineers and data scientists through weekly 1:1s, regular code reviews, and a structured mid-program check-in to keep your growth on track. A Customer Zero experience: you will have used, evaluated, and influenced Teradata’s own AI platform—giving you a rare perspective on enterprise product development that most early-career candidates simply don’t have. Who You’ll Work With You will sit on the Analytics Center of Excellence (CoE) within Teradata’s Enterprise Knowledge Platform & Intelligence Engineering organization, a cross-functional team of solutions analysts, data scientists, data engineers, data modelers, architects, and product managers who translate business needs into scalable analytics solutions.  This role reports to the Director of Analytics CoE.  Day-to-day, you will collaborate closely with data engineers on pipeline design, with AI/ML engineers on agent development, and with DevOps engineers on CI/CD automation—giving you broad exposure to the full analytics delivery lifecycle. What Makes You a Qualified Candidate Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field Working knowledge of SQL and Python for data analysis Comfortable with Git and basic command-line tools Strong communication skills in English; able to explain findings to a non-technical audience Available for a 12–16 week hybrid internship Preferred Curiosity about AI, large language models, or data engineering—whether through coursework, projects, or self-study Exposure to a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or a data visualization tool (Tableau, Power BI) Any experience experimenting with LLM APIs or agentic frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, or similar) What You’ll Bring You are genuinely curious about data and AI—you have explored tools, asked questions, or built something small just to understand how it works. You learn by doing and are not afraid to be wrong; you ask for feedback early and iterate quickly rather than waiting for the perfect answer. You communicate clearly and honestly—when something is confusing or unclear, you say so and ask questions rather than guessing. You care about the quality of your work and the people who will use it, whether that’s a teammate reading your code or a stakeholder relying on your analysis. Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. Optimizar la administración y productividad de los activos comerciales en toda la región, liderando su gobernanza y optimización. Conectar stakeholders y tecnología, explicando decisiones, riesgos y alternativas. Guiar a los equipos promoviendo autonomía y consistencia técnica. Identificar oportunidades reales de AI y resolver problemas técnicos complejos cuando el contexto lo requiera. Identificar riesgos, dependencias, restricciones y deuda técnica. Presentar alternativas y explicar sus trade-offs. Estimar complejidad y dividir soluciones en componentes implementables. Guiar desarrolladores, realizar code reviews y validar estándares técnicos. Participar hands-on ante bloqueos complejos, PoCs, debugging o componentes críticos. Coordinar integraciones entre aplicaciones, APIs, bases de datos y servicios. Trabajar con Product Owners y Delivery Managers para alinear necesidad, viabilidad y ejecución. Mantener comunicación formal con stakeholders sobre decisiones, riesgos y avances técnicos. Presentar y defender propuestas técnicas frente a clientes. No buscamos a quien únicamente diga “esto no se puede hacer” , sino a quien pueda explicar por qué, identificar qué sí es posible y proponer una alternativa. Frontend Angular, TypeScript, componentes, services, routing, forms, integración con APIs, HTML, CSS/SASS y Angular Material. Oracle y WebLogic Oracle Database, PL/SQL, procedures, query optimization, JDBC/JPA, WebLogic Domains, Clusters, EAR/WAR, Data Sources, deployment y troubleshooting. APIs y arquitectura REST, SOAP, OpenAPI, OAuth2, JWT, API Security, sistemas distribuidos, microservicios, Cloud, contenedores, CI/CD, seguridad, observabilidad, resiliencia y modernización legacy. Preventa técnica y discovery con clientes. PoCs y arquitecturas empresariales de GenAI. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot o equivalentes. Competencias Liderazgo técnico, pensamiento crítico, comunicación ejecutiva y técnica, empatía, escucha activa, capacidad consultiva, resolución de problemas, ownership, negociación, orientación al cliente, adaptabilidad, manejo de ambigüedad y orientación a resultados. Indicadores de éxito Los requerimientos ambiguos se convierten en soluciones ejecutables. Los equipos cuentan con dirección técnica clara. Los riesgos se identifican antes de impactar el delivery. Las iniciativas de AI responden a necesidades reales. Puede incorporarse a proyectos con diferentes tecnologías y generar claridad rápidamente. Buscamos a alguien capaz de generar claridad cuando un problema todavía no está bien definido: escuchar al cliente, entender qué necesita realmente, identificar restricciones y convertir la conversación en una solución que el equipo pueda construir. Valoramos una combinación sólida de profundidad técnica, liderazgo, empatía y comunicación . Java, Angular, Oracle y WebLogic serán fortalezas especialmente relevantes, pero no buscamos un perfil limitado por ese stack. Hands-on experience with web analytics, experimentation and performance reporting tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Contentsquare, Hotjar, Optimizely, VWO or similar platforms. Ability to interpret complex data, identify growth opportunities and build clear, commercially grounded recommendations. Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and managing agencies, technology partners or e-commerce accounts. Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions. Title: Supply Chain Management Expert
Description: Summary We are looking for a Supply Chain Management Expert responsible for ensuring product availability through effective supply planning, inventory management, purchase order follow-up, risk mitigation, and cross-functional coordination. This role is key to ensuring supply continuity, optimizing inventory, reducing operational risks, and contributing to service level, efficiency, and business profitability objectives. About The Role Major accountabilities: Translate demand and supply strategies into executable supply plans that ensure product availability while balancing service, inventory, cost, compliance, and operational efficiency. Develop, monitor, and continuously optimize supply plans across complex networks involving multiple products, sites, suppliers, markets, and regulatory requirements. Identify, assess, and mitigate supply risks, including shortages, excess inventory, obsolescence, slow-moving stock, and supply disruptions. Manage inventory performance and key supply chain KPIs, ensuring achievement of service, availability, inventory, and supply plan adherence targets. Collaborate cross-functionally with Demand Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, Warehousing, Logistics, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, and external partners. Support S&OP and S&OE processes through data-driven analysis, scenario planning, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations. Utilize SAP S/4HANA and other ERP systems to manage material planning, inventory, procurement, order management, production, and master data activities. Leverage advanced analytics and digital tools, including Excel, Power BI, and data visualization platforms, to improve supply chain visibility, traceability, and decision-making. Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory optimization, automation, process simplification, waste reduction, data quality enhancement, and operational excellence. Ensure compliance with applicable quality, regulatory, and operational standards while maintaining effective management of batch-controlled and expiry date-sensitive products. Essential Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field. Solid knowledge of end-to-end supply chain processes, supply planning, inventory management, S&OP, key performance indicators, regulatory compliance, and products managed by batch and expiration date. Strong experience working with ERP systems, preferably SAP S/4HANA, as well as advanced analytics and reporting tools such as Excel and Power BI. Proven analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a continuous improvement mindset, strong adaptability to new technologies, and the ability to make data-driven decisions in complex and dynamic environments. Advanced English proficiency with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to effectively collaborate with global teams, suppliers, manufacturing sites, and international business partners. Title: Director of Operations, Service Delivery
Description: About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, spanning three brands: LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome. We've cleared $750M in bookings and turned a profit three years running. Founded in Austin in 2013, we're a team of about 180 that scales past 500 employees during peak season. The marketplace itself is easy to describe and hard to run well: a customer requests a service, we price the job and match it to an eligible Pro, the Pro claims and completes the work, and we process payment and take a commission. We're entering the most ambitious stretch in the company's history as we build new verticals, new software products, and the groundwork to become a multi-billion-dollar company. One of our company values is AI or Extinction: every task, AI-first. No exceptions, no excuses. Top 1% or we're already a fossil. This role is hired against that bar. The Role This is a biz ops generalist role, built for someone who wants to work across many parts of the business instead of owning one narrow lane. You'll start as an individual contributor with no direct reports, in a new seat reporting directly to the COO. Your first owned area will be building Service Delivery into a working operational function. This will entail adding structure, visibility and process to the way we ensure as many customer jobs as possible are completed successfully and on time by LawnStarter Pros, in lawn care and other services we offer now and over time. New projects will show up unscoped over time. That's by design. As LawnStarter enters new verticals and grows toward a multi-billion-dollar future, big problems will keep surfacing with no obvious owner, and you'll be one of the people the COO trusts to run them down. What Makes This Role Different You work on some of the biggest company-wide projects, cutting across teams and functional areas You'll be a top builder in Brain, LawnStarter's internal AI toolkit built on Claude Code that already powers everything we do across the company: metric queries, document drafting, bug triage, and more. We expect you to approach your work in an AI-first fashion, leveraging Brain to build new systems and processes that will push the limits of how fast AI can accelerate business results. Every project you run is built AI-first: the analysis, the tooling, the process automation, the monitoring. You build it yourself instead of waiting on an analyst or engineer You own outcomes end to end, from recommendation through execution. Strategy without follow-through doesn't count here What You'll Own Service Delivery, from the ground up. Despite LawnStarter's considerable scale and reach, Service Delivery doesn't exist yet as a dedicated function. You'll help define the standards we should meet for job completion rates and speed, measure whether we hit them, and design processes, incentives and real-time interventions that get tested with Pros and customers in the field to lift performance. Scope covers every vertical and every delivery model, from today's 1099 Pros to potential W-2 crews under future evaluation Raising customer & Pro retention rates. When we deliver service with excellence, Pros and customers alike stay with us longer. Working tightly with peers across Product, Data and Support, you'll identify new opportunities for us to boost retention and LTV and play a key role in driving resulting initiatives cross-functionally Whatever comes next. New projects will land on your plate as the company grows into new verticals and builds new software products. You'll take them from "we should look into this" to building and then running systems with structure, KPIs and owners Problems to Solve Build a Service Delivery function that doesn't exist yet. Right now, no one formally owns whether LawnStarter delivers the service it promises. You'll define the standard for what a Pro should deliver, then build the agents and pipelines that measure adherence to it and run the tests that change behaviors and outcomes in the field. Move metrics. Leverage systems thinking and AI expertise to drive business results that sit across various functional teams. That means untangling handoffs where several teams touch a problem or goal and no one team owns the outcome. Take unscoped problems from ideas to fully-running and automated systems. Some of the most important work here hasn't been named yet. At some point, someone will raise a fuzzy, unframed problem and say it needs attention. Your job is to take that starting point and build whatever tooling or process it needs, at record speed, and hand back something that runs, with a clear owner and quantitative targets attached. What Success Looks Like (Year 1) Service Delivery is a working function with a defined (and elevated) service standard, a way to measure adherence to it, clear SOPs, and an intervention and incentive playbook that's been tested and proven to lift results At least one project nobody had scoped a year earlier has gone from "we should look into this" to a heavily-automated, running system with a named owner and tracked KPIs Tools you built with AI are in daily use by people other than you, and the way you work has raised the bar for how the company uses AI The COO can hand you a gray-area problem with no playbook and trust that what comes back is data, a recommendation, and a plan to execute it Requirements Who You Are An elite AI builder. You think in terms of agentic systems. Building agents, evals, context engineering, and thinking in guardrails are core to who you are. You keep up with the frontier and put new capabilities to work within days, not quarters. You'd be in the top few percent of AI users at any company you've worked at. Someone who treats AI as an occasional assistant, or needs an engineer to build tooling for them, isn't the right fit here. A zero-to-one operator. You've taken ambiguous, cross-team operating problems from zero to running systems as an individual contributor, with no team to hand the work to. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your experience stops at executing a scope someone else already defined. Marketplace-tested. You've operated inside a marketplace or another multi-sided business and felt firsthand what it takes to balance the needs of different stakeholders on the supply and demand sides. A background built entirely on single-sided businesses, with one stakeholder type to satisfy, won't translate here. A finisher. Executing what you recommend matters as much to you as the recommendation itself. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you treat strategy as your job and execution as someone else's. A partner who can help drive strategy collaboratively. You work well with people who don't report to you and are a savvy cross-departmental collaborator on priorities and sequencing. If you need formal authority to effect change, this role isn't for you. Data-driven by reflex. You'd rather build the query or the dashboard than argue from a hunch. This is unlikely to be a good fit if, when ambiguity hits, your first move is to guess and move on instead of digging for the number. At home in unresolved ambiguity. Scope shifts as priorities do, and problems arrive unframed more often than not. That's the norm here, not an exception. Degree in analytics, business or related field, with 7+ years of experience in marketplace operations or equivalent roles. This Role Is NOT A people-management role. There's no team to build or manage, at least not to start A strategy-only seat. You'll execute what you recommend, not hand it off to someone else to run A fit for anyone who isn't already an elite AI builder. The AI bar on this team isn't aspirational; it's the baseline we hire against Benefits Compensation & Benefits Base salary: $120,000 to $135,000 Fully remote: This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours Flexible PTO: Measured on outcomes, not hours logged VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume. Applications without it will not be considered LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.

Title: Senior RevOps Engineer
Description: About Improvado Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance. We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution. About the role Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team. What you will do Salesforce and GTM stack Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing). Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals. Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires. Contract to cash Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent. Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat. Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports. Revenue analytics and data model Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs). Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing. Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks. Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner. AI and automation Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output. Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided. Ownership Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric. Requirements 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org. Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus. Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals. Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM. Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use. Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked. Nice to have Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification. ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool. Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API). Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools. Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems. HubSpot to Salesforce migration. Attribution or CS health score data. Martech or analytics company background. What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement Powered by JazzHR

Influencia sin autoridad jerárquica para alinear equipos multifuncionales y asegurar la ejecución. Comunicación franca hacia arriba, bajo ego y estándares altos.
